sentences.en: The police ascribed the automobile accident to reckless driving.
sentences.zh: 警方将那起汽车事故归因于驾驶不当。

sentences.en: His failure is not to be ascribed to want of diligence.
sentences.zh: 他的失败不能归咎于缺乏勤奋。

sentences.en: Her failure is not to be ascribed to want of diligence.
sentences.zh: 她的失败不能归咎于缺乏勤奋。

senses.zh: 将...归因于；把...归于；认为...是...的原因

mnemonic: 词根记忆：a（加强）+scrib（写）+e →把账记在…头上→归因于
